description: count of distinct patients who have a given condition
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '66383009' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: list of distinct patients currently prescribed a given medication
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
            FROM medication_request
            WHERE code = '313782' AND code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' AND status = 'active'

description: count of distinct patients allergic to a given substance
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM allergy
            WHERE code = '609328004' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: count of administered doses of a given vaccine
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS dose_count
            FROM immunization
            WHERE code = '140' AND code_system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx' AND status = 'completed'

description: list of distinct patients who had a given procedure performed
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT patient_id
            FROM procedure
            WHERE code = '171207006' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND status = 'completed'

description: average recorded value of a given observation across all patients
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
SELECT AVG(value_quantity) AS avg_value, value_unit
            FROM observation
            WHERE code = '777-3' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org'
            GROUP BY value_unit

description: count of a given diagnostic report type issued
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS report_count
            FROM diagnostic_report
            WHERE code = '34117-2' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org'

description: count of encounters of a given type
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS encounter_count
            FROM encounter
            WHERE code = '162673000' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: count of distinct patients with a given condition currently marked active
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '66383009' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND clinical_status = 'active'

description: count of a given condition's diagnoses that have since resolved (abatement recorded)
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS resolved_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '66383009' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND abatement_date IS NOT NULL

description: count of new diagnoses of a given condition, grouped by year
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM onset_date) AS diagnosis_year, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '66383009' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND onset_date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY diagnosis_year
            ORDER BY diagnosis_year

description: count of a given medication's prescriptions broken down by status
sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS request_count
            FROM medication_request
            WHERE code = '313782' AND code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
            GROUP BY status
            ORDER BY request_count DESC

description: count of prescriptions for a given medication issued per year
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM authored_date) AS rx_year, COUNT(*) AS rx_count
            FROM medication_request
            WHERE code = '313782' AND code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm' AND authored_date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY rx_year
            ORDER BY rx_year

description: count and average of a given observation's readings above a clinically notable threshold
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS high_reading_count, AVG(value_quantity) AS avg_high_value
            FROM observation
            WHERE code = '777-3' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org' AND value_quantity > 370

description: average value of a given observation grouped by year recorded
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effective_date) AS obs_year, AVG(value_quantity) AS avg_value
            FROM observation
            WHERE code = '777-3' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org' AND effective_date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY obs_year
            ORDER BY obs_year

description: count of a given procedure performed per year
sql:
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM performed_date) AS proc_year, COUNT(*) AS proc_count
            FROM procedure
            WHERE code = '171207006' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND performed_date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY proc_year
            ORDER BY proc_year

description: count of patients allergic to a given substance broken down by criticality
sql:
SELECT criticality, COUNT(DISTINCT patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM allergy
            WHERE code = '609328004' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY criticality

description: count of encounters of a given type per status
sql:
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count
            FROM encounter
            WHERE code = '162673000' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY status
            ORDER BY encounter_count DESC

description: count of patients with a given condition, broken down by gender
sql:
SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY p.gender

description: count of patients over 65 who have a given condition
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND DATE_DIFF('year', p.birth_date, c.onset_date) >= 65

description: average body weight of patients who have a given condition
sql:
SELECT AVG(o.value_quantity) AS avg_weight, o.value_unit
            FROM condition c
            JOIN observation o ON c.patient_id = o.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND o.code = '29463-7' AND o.code_system = 'http://loinc.org'
            GROUP BY o.value_unit

description: count of patients on a given medication who also have a given condition (paired with a fixed common condition -- hypertension)
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT m.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM medication_request m
            JOIN condition c ON m.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE m.code = '313782' AND m.code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: count of a given procedure broken down by the encounter type it occurred in
sql:
SELECT e.code AS encounter_code, e.display AS encounter_display, COUNT(*) AS procedure_count
            FROM procedure pr
            JOIN encounter e ON pr.encounter_id = e.encounter_id
            WHERE pr.code = '171207006' AND pr.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY e.code, e.display
            ORDER BY procedure_count DESC

description: count of patients who received a given immunization, broken down by gender
sql:
SELECT p.gender, COUNT(DISTINCT i.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM immunization i
            JOIN patient p ON i.patient_id = p.patient_id
            WHERE i.code = '140' AND i.code_system = 'http://hl7.org/fhir/sid/cvx'
            GROUP BY p.gender

description: average number of procedures performed per patient among those who have a given condition
sql:
SELECT AVG(proc_count) AS avg_procedures_per_patient
            FROM (
                SELECT c.patient_id, COUNT(pr.procedure_id) AS proc_count
                FROM condition c
                LEFT JOIN procedure pr ON c.patient_id = pr.patient_id
                WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ) sub

description: count of a given diagnostic report type generated for patients who have hypertension
sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS report_count
            FROM diagnostic_report dr
            JOIN condition c ON dr.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE dr.code = '34117-2' AND dr.code_system = 'http://loinc.org'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: count of patients whose given observation reading exceeds a threshold and who are prescribed lisinopril
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM observation o
            JOIN medication_request m ON o.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE o.code = '777-3' AND o.code_system = 'http://loinc.org' AND o.value_quantity > 370
              AND m.code = '314076' AND m.code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'

description: count of patients with a given allergy who also have anemia
sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a.patient_id) AS patient_count
            FROM allergy a
            JOIN condition c ON a.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE a.code = '609328004' AND a.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND c.code = '271737000' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'

description: average number of encounters per patient among those diagnosed with a given condition
sql:
SELECT AVG(enc_count) AS avg_encounters_per_patient
            FROM (
                SELECT c.patient_id, COUNT(DISTINCT e.encounter_id) AS enc_count
                FROM condition c
                LEFT JOIN encounter e ON c.patient_id = e.patient_id
                WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
                GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ) sub

description: count of a given medication's prescriptions broken down by the encounter class they were authored in
sql:
SELECT e.class_code, COUNT(*) AS rx_count
            FROM medication_request m
            JOIN encounter e ON m.encounter_id = e.encounter_id
            WHERE m.code = '313782' AND m.code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
            GROUP BY e.class_code
            ORDER BY rx_count DESC

description: average patient age at the time a given procedure was performed
sql:
SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birth_date, pr.performed_date)) AS avg_age_at_procedure
            FROM procedure pr
            JOIN patient p ON pr.patient_id = p.patient_id
            WHERE pr.code = '171207006' AND pr.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND pr.performed_date IS NOT NULL

description: for each patient, the change in a given observation's value between their first and most recent recorded reading
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
WITH ranked AS (
                SELECT patient_id, value_quantity, effective_date,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effective_date ASC) AS rn_first,
                       ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY patient_id ORDER BY effective_date DESC) AS rn_last
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '777-3' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org' AND value_quantity IS NOT NULL
            )
            SELECT f.patient_id, f.value_quantity AS first_value, l.value_quantity AS last_value,
                   l.value_quantity - f.value_quantity AS delta
            FROM (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_first = 1) f
            JOIN (SELECT * FROM ranked WHERE rn_last = 1) l ON f.patient_id = l.patient_id
            WHERE f.patient_id != l.patient_id OR f.effective_date != l.effective_date

description: for each patient with a given condition, their most recent reading of a given observation (uses a fixed anchor condition -- hypertension)
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
SELECT o.patient_id, o.value_quantity, o.effective_date
            FROM observation o
            JOIN condition c ON o.patient_id = c.patient_id
            WHERE o.code = '777-3' AND o.code_system = 'http://loinc.org'
              AND c.code = '59621000' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY o.patient_id ORDER BY o.effective_date DESC) = 1

description: patients diagnosed with a given condition who had a colonoscopy within 90 days afterward
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT c.patient_id
            FROM condition c
            JOIN procedure pr ON c.patient_id = pr.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND pr.code = '73761001' AND pr.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND pr.performed_date BETWEEN c.onset_date AND c.onset_date + INTERVAL 90 DAY

description: the 5 patients with the most prescriptions of a given medication
sql:
SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS rx_count
            FROM medication_request
            WHERE code = '313782' AND code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
            GROUP BY patient_id
            ORDER BY rx_count DESC
            LIMIT 5

description: patients who had 3 or more encounters of a given type within any 12-month window (approximated via calendar-year grouping)
sql:
SELECT patient_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) AS enc_year, COUNT(*) AS encounter_count
            FROM encounter
            WHERE code = '185347001' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct' AND start_date IS NOT NULL
            GROUP BY patient_id, enc_year
            HAVING COUNT(*) >= 3

description: the 5 patients with the most recorded diagnoses of a given condition (recurrence)
sql:
SELECT patient_id, COUNT(*) AS diagnosis_count
            FROM condition
            WHERE code = '66383009' AND code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY patient_id
            ORDER BY diagnosis_count DESC
            LIMIT 5

description: average number of days between diagnosis of a given condition and the first lisinopril prescription for the same patient
sql:
SELECT AVG(DATE_DIFF('day', c.onset_date, m.first_rx)) AS avg_days_to_treatment
            FROM condition c
            JOIN (
                SELECT patient_id, MIN(authored_date) AS first_rx
                FROM medication_request
                WHERE code = '314076' AND code_system = 'http://www.nlm.nih.gov/research/umls/rxnorm'
                GROUP BY patient_id
            ) m ON c.patient_id = m.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
              AND m.first_rx >= c.onset_date

description: year-over-year change in the average value of a given observation
display: Platelets [#/volume] in Blood by Automated count
sql:
WITH yearly AS (
                SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effective_date) AS yr, AVG(value_quantity) AS avg_val
                FROM observation
                WHERE code = '777-3' AND code_system = 'http://loinc.org' AND effective_date IS NOT NULL
                GROUP BY yr
            )
            SELECT yr, avg_val, avg_val - LAG(avg_val) OVER (ORDER BY yr) AS yoy_delta
            FROM yearly
            ORDER BY yr

description: for each patient, their age at first diagnosis of a given condition, oldest 5 shown
sql:
SELECT c.patient_id, MIN(DATE_DIFF('year', p.birth_date, c.onset_date)) AS age_at_first_diagnosis
            FROM condition c
            JOIN patient p ON c.patient_id = p.patient_id
            WHERE c.code = '66383009' AND c.code_system = 'http://snomed.info/sct'
            GROUP BY c.patient_id
            ORDER BY age_at_first_diagnosis DESC
            LIMIT 5
